title: Comprehensive Omics Analysis of Pediatric Tumors and Establishment of a Repository for Related Biological Studies
description: The Center for Cancer Research (CCR), of the intramural NCI undertook a multidimensional clinical genomics study of children and adolescent young adults with relapsed and refractory cancers who were enrolled on other therapeutic trials to determine the feasibility of a genome guided precision therapy protocol in these patients.Note: NCIPM001blood - This sample was previously submitted with study phs002207, with sample ID NCIPM001blood_E and SRR ID SRR18544311.
